entries.failure_mode: Reference gap artifact: The 10 majorclass vocabulary lacks an independent endothelial class; vascular clusters are forcibly assigned to microglia by the engine, creating high-confidence false positives.
entries.observable_signature: dr-sc cluster 31: Engine arm Micro share 83.4% vs. Reading arm Endo (E-b registered).
entries.mitigation: Vascular/endothelial conclusions must rely on independent marker reading (PECA1/CDH5/PLVAP) and explicitly disclose 'reference gaps'; engine output alone cannot serve as Endo evidence.

provenance.home_rationale: Evidence is only measured within human × retina grid (HRCA vocabulary + current engine combination); no cross-grid dual evidence, so not promoted.

entries.failure_mode: Degraded/low-quality rod clusters are hijacked into glial naming or collectively abstained (Rod quality axis).
entries.observable_signature: Named assignments for low-depth + high-MT clusters systematically drift between engine and reading.
entries.mitigation: Attach quality flags (MT%/stress dissociation score) to photoreceptor clusters before entering the naming workflow; named assignments for Rod quality axis clusters (low depth + high MT) must have reduced confidence and be listed separately.
links: /mnt/D/EyeKB/plans/drsc_reann_test_20260930/DRSC_REANN_PREREG.md E-c + REPORT §4 exemption group; DRSC_PI_ADJUDICATION_sheet_20260930.md rows for clusters 3/11/13/14

provenance.home_rationale: Photoreceptor quality axis is specific to retina.

entries.failure_mode: Low-depth ambient trap: True BCs contaminated by rod ambient RNA are misread as 'low rod amplitude → bipolar cell' blind spot zone.
entries.observable_signature: Named BCs appear in rod-dominated clusters; without ambient decomposition, misjudgment evidence is inseparable.
entries.mitigation: Before citing 'a band was misjudged', ambient proportion decomposition (decontX/cellbender level) must be performed simultaneously; do not use true BCs contaminated by ambient RNA as evidence of misjudgment; when rod-dominated clusters are judged as BCs, re-review as soft hints.

provenance.home_rationale: Phenomenon limited to retina photoreceptor-dominated materials; cite registered evidence from internal blind spot cards.

entries.failure_mode: The training pool of this system has only 863 cells for the RPE panel; 10-class engine/small panel entries cannot produce RPE conclusions.
entries.observable_signature: RPE class recall collapse/high-confidence misclassification (compared against external purified data).
entries.mitigation: RPE conclusions must not originate from 10-class engine/small panel entries; requires external purified RPE data (GSE189770 type) or an independent RPE panel; note SIGNOFF citation caution ④ when referencing old results.

provenance.home_rationale: System applicability domain statement (answer-independent); evidence anchor D001 pool size = fact within grid.

entries.note: Manual re-review required for all RPE named assignments in this system until external data or independent panels are promoted.

entries.failure_mode: Regional mixing false flag: fovea vs peripheral sampling differences misinterpreted as composition anomalies
entries.observable_signature: Composition proportions of samples from different regions within the same tissue exhibit bimodality
entries.mitigation: Composition controls must first align by region (macula/fovea/peripheral columns; absence of region metadata = no control possible, description only); register gaps in foveola-level references without forcing alignment.

provenance.home_rationale: fovea/peripheral are specific to human retinal anatomy; the orthogonal region axis was established with C8 approval (v1 §3.1),This entry adds a region_scope annotation to mitigate the syntactic executability of 'align control regions first'.

entries.note: See v1 §3.1 for the four-value semantics of region_scope; not_recorded samples are reported as mixed surfaces, prohibited from being applied as single-surface fovea/peripheral assumptions.

entries.failure_mode: Systematic evaluation of dissociation/storage bias is on record; rare class recovery depends on nuclear suspensions—methodological confounders must be deducted before interpreting biological differences.
entries.observable_signature: Differences in rare class recovery rates between scRNA/snRNA are reproducible in literature comparisons of both systems.
entries.mitigation: Dissociation protocol differences are disclosed as methodological confounders, prohibited from interpretation as biological differences.
links: PMID:32487174｜Systematic assessment of tissue dissociation and storage biases in single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq workflows. Genome Biol 2020
